title: Registration Opens for THRIVELIVE 2027 in Las Vegas
html:
By News Staff

November 10, 2026

Share

Registration is now open for THRIVELIVE 2027, an annual dental industry event co-hosted by Henry Schein, Inc. and Henry Schein One. The event will return to Resorts World Las Vegas from April 28 through May 1, 2027, offering continuing education, networking opportunities, and entertainment for dental professionals and their teams.

Attendees will be able to choose from more than 100 educational courses and earn up to 15 continuing education (CE) credits. The event will also feature presentations and opportunities to explore practice technologies and solutions, including Ascend by Dentrix.

For 2027, THRIVELIVE is expanding its educational programming through collaborations with the American Association of Dental Office Management (AADOM), BioHorizons, Dykema, Spear, and 3Shape. According to the organizers, these partnerships are intended to broaden the range of educational content available to dentists and other dental practice team members.

The event will also introduce suggested educational paths designed to help attendees select courses and activities based on their practice priorities. These paths will address topics such as revenue growth, operational efficiency, practice expansion, and team leadership.

In addition to its educational programming, THRIVELIVE will include evening entertainment. Previous events have featured comedian Howie Mandel and skateboarder Tony Hawk. The organizers plan to announce the 2027 speaker lineup and headlining entertainer at a later date.

Ultra Early Bird registration is available through December 31, 2026, providing access to early course enrollment and registration rates before scheduled increases.

More information is available at https://thrivelive2027.com/.
